name: engram-desktop-opencode-vendor
description: Isolated install root for the opencode-engram-learning plugin and its own dependency tree (Effect, the OpenCode plugin SDK, a private zod@4 — distinct from the app's own zod@3). Vendored here rather than left in the app's top-level node_modules so electron-builder's extraResources step can copy exactly this subtree into the packaged app, unbundled, for OpenCode's own Bun-based plugin loader to resolve at runtime. Never imported by app code directly.
